readmeExcerpt: Qrisp is a high-level quantum programming framework that allows for intuitive development of quantum algorithms. It provides a rich set of tools and abstractions to make quantum computing more accessible to developers and researchers. By automating many steps one usually encounters when programming a quantum computer, introducing quantum types, and many more features Qrisp makes quantum programming more user-friendly yet stays performant when it comes to compiling programs to the circuit level.
